name: Camping Erlebnis Zugspitze
beschreibung: Camping Erlebnis Zugspitze is located in Garmisch-Partenkirchen in Tyrol and belongs to the campsite category. The complex offers pitches for motorhomes and caravans as well as tent meadows in quiet surroundings. Its proximity to the Zugspitze massif allows for easy excursions on foot or by train. The campsite features modern sanitary facilities and a small shop for daily essentials. Leisure opportunities include hiking and cycling directly from the grounds. A nearby bus stop provides convenient access to the public transport network.
